notes: A is the arguments of the example call `import numpy as np ; N = 16 ; rs = np.random.RandomState(16) ; b = 0.1 ; c = 1.1 ; a = b + c * rs.uniform(-2., 2., N) ; log_likelihood(a, b, c)`. Changed for Q32: the data are drawn (seeded) within 2 sigma of the mean instead of np.arange(16.), which reaches about 13.5 sigma, where exp(-(x-mean)^2 / 2 sigma^2) is about 1e-40, 0 in Q32, and log(0) is undefined. B is a seeded perturbation of A (numpy RandomState(3903821)): noise 10 % of the largest magnitude; integer arrays redrawn in their range.
